user.title: Add plant
user.description: Name the plant. To use species care ranges, type part of its name to search OpenPlantbook; leave the search empty to add the plant without a species.

data_description.species_search: Latin or common name, e.g. monstera.

data_description.species_pid: Matches from OpenPlantbook. Leave empty to add the plant without a species.
data_description.location_type: Indoor plants use room sensors; outdoor plants use weather and rain.
data_description.area_id: Room or place where the plant lives. Change it later by moving the plant's device.
data_description.soil_moisture_entity: Optional. When set, it takes priority over the estimate.
data_description.weather_entity: Outdoor plants only. Leave empty to use the hub default.
data_description.initial_watering_interval_days: Starting interval in days; it adapts to the watering you log.
data_description.feeding_interval_days: Days between feedings in spring and summer; longer in autumn and winter.

reconfigure.title: Edit plant
reconfigure.description: Rename the plant. To change its species, search OpenPlantbook again; leave the search empty to keep the current species.

data_description.species_search: Latin or common name, e.g. monstera.

reconfigure_details.title: Plant details
reconfigure_details.description: To move the plant to another room, change the area of its device. Range fields override the OpenPlantbook values; leave them empty to use the species defaults.
